title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total electric field at midpoint O as E = 24kQ/r².

title: Electric field direction
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the net electric field direction as from sphere A to sphere B.

title: Superposition principle
description: Important: Applies vector superposition of electric fields from both point charges at the midpoint.

title: Charge redistribution
description: Important: Correctly determines that after contact, charges equalize to -2Q on each sphere.

title: Force ratio calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the force ratio F₁/F₂ = 4/5 after contact.

title: Coulomb's law application
description: Important: Uses Coulomb's law correctly for both pre- and post-contact force calculations.

title: Sign error in fields
description: Pitfall: Adds electric field magnitudes instead of considering their opposite directions at midpoint.

title: Charge conservation
description: Important: Applies charge conservation during contact (total charge = -4Q).

title: Distance oversight
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect distance (r instead of r/2) for electric field calculations at midpoint.
